//: Declaration emit only. Zx is written in plain ES2022 with JSDoc types — there is no
TypeScript in the sources and no TypeScript in the build output. This config exists so that
the types already written for humans are also handed to editors: `tsc` reads the JSDoc and
`checkJs` is deliberately off here. Turning it on is worthwhile and is tracked separately —
it would turn every JSDoc inaccuracy into a build failure on the day it is switched on, which
is a change to make on purpose rather than as a side effect of shipping declarations.
